structure.unit: Heat, Light, Power, Water and Other Utility Companies Generally

law.catch_line: Duties of water and sewerage companies in certain counties
law.text: Chapter 298 of the Acts of 1950, approved April 4, 1950, requiring water and sewerage companies in any county adjoining a county having a population in excess of 2,000 per square mile, to furnish a supply of water sufficient for health and fire protection, is incorporated in this Code by this reference.
